description: Detect the PIE pulses (micro time) or µs-ALEX alternation (macro time) of a measurement, propose prompt/delayed windows, and check a setup's windows against the data.

accepts.name: measurement
accepts.summary: A photon stream whose excitation pulses (PIE) or alternation (µs-ALEX) are detected.

accepts.name: setup
accepts.summary: A detector setup whose windows are checked against the measurement.

rpc_methods.name: excitation_windows.detect
rpc_methods.summary: Detect the excitation scheme of a measurement (pie / alex / single / unclear) and propose windows.

rpc_methods.name: excitation_windows.check
rpc_methods.summary: Check a setup's windows against a measurement: issues with severity and a proposal.
